messages:
support-alex: FYI — multiple customers opened support tickets about 5xx/timeouts hitting hosted /v1/generate since ~09:30 PST. Errors spike then fall. attaching first ticket links.

sre-june: Noted. Any correlation with deploys or autoscaler events?

eng-ryan: Checking deploy history now, no prod deploys in last hour. Looking at edge logs.

maria-ops: Seeing an ingress fanout increase from EU region at 09:28, p90 latency up then timeouts. Could be upstream throttle.

support-alex: Customer repro steps (from ticket): single req to hosted model -> sometimes returns 502, often 504 after ~15s. Happens on both streaming and non-streaming.

eng-ryan: Quick grep of gateway logs: spike of `503` and `504` from inference-proxy with `conn-pool-exhaustion` tags. Dumping a small sample: ```
[INF] call_id=abc123 upstream_error=connection_reset conn_pool=exhausted
[INF] call_id=def456 queue_wait_ms=12000 final_status=timeout
```

sre-june: That matches conn pool exhaustion. Are batchers backing up? Any evidence of KV cache stalls?

todd-ml: On model side, one worker VM shows elevated GPU mem pressure and slow KV hits — could push batch latency up. I've opened an SSH session to one instance.

maria-ops: Autoscaler triggered scale-up but new instances took ~90s to become healthy, causing transient shortage.

support-alex: Customers asking for ETA and short mitigation suggestions for them.

eng-ryan: Immediate mitigation: enable fallback routing to smaller LG model for affected routes and increase per-instance conn pool size temporarily. Rolling a config now.

deploy-bot: config-rollout: route-fallbacks v1 -> started by eng-ryan at 09:44:12 UTC, target 20% traffic to fallback variant.

billing-sam: If we route to fallback smaller model we should flag cost/quality impact and notify customers. I can draft comms.

support-alex: Please add a short note in the tickets about temporary fallback and expected latency improvement.

eng-ryan: Rollout completed to 30% by 09:46. Early metrics: p95 latency down from 8.2s to 1.6s for fallback traffic, overall 5xx rate dropping.

sre-june: Action items I'd track: 1) investigate conn pool sizing defaults, 2) review autoscaler warmup/health check speed, 3) find root cause of GPU mem pressure on that worker, 4) improve circuit-breaker fallback thresholds.

todd-ml: I'll capture model-side traces + KV cache hit rates and open an infra ticket for suspected memory leak on that instance.

maria-ops: I'll add an autoscaler tuning ticket (priority P1) and add a warmup probe to reduce time-to-ready.

eng-ryan: I'll follow up on gateway conn pool default, propose increasing pool by 50% for heavy-fanout routes as a quick config.

billing-sam: I'll prepare customer comms and a short FYI on billing effects.

support-alex: Will update affected customer tickets and set expectation of follow-up postmortem.

sre-june: For the postmortem draft: include timeline, impacted customers, mitigation (fallback routing + pool bump), root-cause candidates (autoscaler warmup + instance mem pressure), and action owners + ETA. Let's schedule a 30-min postmortem sync at 14:00 PST.

eng-ryan: Assigning owners now: conn pool -> eng-ryan; autoscaler warmup -> maria-ops; model mem trace -> todd-ml; customer comms -> billing-sam; postmortem doc -> sre-june.

support-alex: Thanks — tickets updated. I'll ping customers after billing-sam approves message.

eng-ryan: Quick repro snippet for infra team to exercise (from prod-like env): ```bash
ab -n 200 -c 10 https://hosted.example/api/v1/generate -p payload.json -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
``` Use long prompt variety to trigger longer KV usage.

sre-june: Saving logs and metrics snapshot to incident folder incident/1798302461. We'll reconvene after owners have initial findings. :thumbsup:

support-alex: closing loop here for the chat — mitigation holds, customers notified. Postmortem sync 14:00 PST.

maria-ops: quick note: put autoscaler warmup experiment behind a feature flag first, will test in canary.

eng-ryan: Will follow up with PR for conn-pool bump and circuit-breaker tuning later today.

sre-june: Thanks all — good containment.
